summary: The customer called in extreme frustration, demanding an immediate account closure due to unresolved internet complaints lasting two months. The agent attempted to calm the customer and investigate, but ultimately agreed to proceed with the account cancellation procedures after the customer refused troubleshooting.

evidence.text: رح أبلش بـ procedures إلغاء الحساب.
evidence.speaker: Agent

evidence.text: مرحبًا معك الشركة، كيف بقدر أساعدك اليوم؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

compliance_flags.description: The agent failed to state their own name and the specific name of the company at the beginning of the call.

evidence.text: ولا يهمك سيدي، خليني أعمل check للـ system وأشوف وين الـ problem بالضبط.
evidence.speaker: Agent

compliance_flags.description: The agent proceeded to discuss account system checks without verifying the customer's identity first.

evidence.text: سيدي أرجوك تهدا، ليش بدك تعمل الـ closure؟ شو المشكلة صارت؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent told the customer to calm down rather than using professional de-escalation techniques, though they remained relatively composed.

evidence.text: ولا يهمك سيدي، خليني أعمل check للـ system وأشوف وين الـ problem بالضبط.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent acknowledged the customer's frustration with a supportive phrase ('ولا يهمك'), but failed to deeply address the two-month grievance.

evidence.text: رح أبلش بـ procedures إلغاء الحساب.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The resolution was simply giving in to account closure rather than salvaging the customer relationship or resolving the underlying technical issue.

evidence.text: عم بحاول أساعدك عشان ما تخسر الـ offers، بس تمام، رح أبلش بـ procedures إلغاء الحساب.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent's communication was clear and straightforward, though heavily mixed with Arabic and English code-switching.

evidence.text: يلا بسرعة خلصنا، ومش رح أدف ولا قرش زيادة على الـ bill الأخيرة، سامع؟
evidence.speaker: Customer

rubric_scores.justification: The call ended abruptly with the customer shouting demands and threats about the bill without a proper professional closing from the agent.

evidence.text: ولا يهمك سيدي، خليني أعمل check للـ system وأشوف وين الـ problem بالضبط.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent offered to check the system, but the information provided was generic and did not resolve the technical complaint.

evidence.text: مرحبًا معك الشركة، كيف بقدر أساعدك اليوم؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent violated multiple basic procedures including failing to identify themselves, name the company, and verify customer identity.

quote.text: أنا طالع روحي منكم، بدي أسكر الـ account تاعي فورًا!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: ما بدي check ولا بدي شي منك! Just close my account خلاص زهقت!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: يلا بسرعة خلصنا، ومش رح أدف ولا قرش زيادة على الـ bill الأخيرة، سامع؟
quote.speaker: Customer
